verified_facts.text: The hotel is at 5 Rue de la Paix in Paris's 2nd arrondissement.
verified_facts.excerpt: 5 Rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris, France

verified_facts.text: Place Vendome and the Opera Garnier are steps from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Place Vendôme and Opéra Garnier are just steps away.

verified_facts.text: SEOK serves Korean cuisine inspired by the traditions and hospitality of Seoul.
verified_facts.excerpt: SEOK offers authentic and generous Korean cuisine inspired by the traditions and hospitality of Seoul.

verified_facts.text: Restaurant PUR' was redesigned by artist-architect Hugo Toro in fall 2024.
verified_facts.excerpt: After all those years, the restaurant finally got the design refresh it deserved in fall 2024.

verified_facts.text: PUR' pairs the designs of artist-architect Hugo Toro with the cooking of chef Jean-Francois Rouquette.
verified_facts.excerpt: blending the visionary designs of artist-architect Hugo Toro with the culinary brilliance of Michelin-starred Chef Jean-François Rouquette

verified_facts.text: PUR' offers contemporary French cuisine with an exclusive Chef's Table experience.
verified_facts.excerpt: invites guests to discover contemporary French cuisine, enhanced by the exclusive Chef's Table experience

verified_facts.text: The spa partners exclusively with the La Mer cosmetics brand.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel exclusively partners with the prestigious La Mer cosmetics brand.

verified_facts.text: The spa has a jetted tub, a sauna, a steam room and treatment rooms including one for couples.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled beside the inviting jetted tub, the cozy relaxation lounge is surrounded by a sauna, a steam room and 4 exquisite treatment rooms (including one duo).

verified_facts.text: Hairstylist John Nollet runs a hair salon in Suite 101 of the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: John Nollet offers an exceptional range of exclusive cutting and care protocols in his Suite 101.

verified_facts.text: All rooms were updated in 2017 by American designer Ed Tuttle in a warm neutral and gold palette.
verified_facts.excerpt: All rooms, including mine on the sixth floor (639), were updated in 2017 by American designer Ed Tuttle in a warm neutral and gold palette.

verified_facts.text: Sixth-floor rooms have balconies with views of Parisian rooftops and Place Vendome.
verified_facts.excerpt: The sixth and top floor benefits from unobstructed views of Parisian rooftops and even the Place Vendôme from the room's balconies.

verified_facts.text: Deluxe rooms have limestone bathrooms with a deep soaking tub and separate rainfall shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: The elegant limestone bathroom features a deep soaking tub and separate rainfall shower.

verified_facts.text: Perfumer Christophe Laudamiel created the hotel's signature scent.
verified_facts.excerpt: Here, he created both the signature olfactive scent for the entirety of the hotel spaces

verified_facts.text: L'Appartement is a private apartment with a view over the roofs of Paris.
verified_facts.excerpt: It’s artfully designed, offers five-star service and features a view over the roofs of Paris.

verified_facts.text: Cafe Jeanne serves an all-day menu at the bar, by the fireplace or on the terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Whether installed at the bar counter, in the restaurant seats, near the fireplace or on the terrace, a unique menu made up of gastronomic essentials is offered all day long until late night.

verified_facts.text: La Terrasse du Park is a sunlit terrace in the heart of the hotel, sheltered by historic facades.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in the heart of the hotel, sheltered by historic facades, this charming, sunlit terrace is the perfect spot to enjoy springtime lunches and lively dinners.

verified_facts.text: Cafe Jeanne offers La Biscuiterie, a seasonal experience by chef Narae Kim.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover "La Biscuiterie" experience, a unique and seasonal culinary journey crafted by Chef Narae Kim.

verified_facts.text: Le Chalet du Park will reopen on November 16, 2026.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Chalet du Park will reopen on November 16, 2026

verified_facts.text: Pets are welcome for a daily fee, but not in Restaurant PUR' or the spa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pets are not allowed at Restaurant PUR' - Jean-François Rouquette and our Spa.

verified_facts.text: Opera metro station, served by lines 3, 7 and 8, is nearby.
verified_facts.excerpt: Metro lines 3, 7 and 8 at Opéra Metro Station provide access to the Louvre, Champ de Mars, Notre-Dame Cathedral and more.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has nearly 700 square meters of meeting and event space.
verified_facts.excerpt: With nearly 700 square meters (7,500 square feet) of customizable space

verified_facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler readers named the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards in 2017, 2018, 2019, 2021, 2023, 2025 and 2026.
